sheets.prompt: Character design reference sheet for a science fiction exploration game: one oracle, a defunct hovering caster droid of an ancient vanished civilisation, drawn four times side by side at the same scale on a plain cream background: front view, side view, three-quarter view, and its attack wind-up with both hands raised and a sphere of amber light gathering between them. A small cloaked human traveller with a round jade backpack stands beside it for scale; the oracle is 1.8 metres tall and floats a hand's breadth off the ground. Design: a person's head, shoulders and two thin arms, its body ending in a tapering ceramic shell instead of legs; a tall smooth head with one large round amber eye; pale ivory ceramic panels over dark joints, a slowly turning ring around its shoulders; weathered, chipped and stained with age, glowing amber seams. Calm and eerie. Original design, medium detail, a strong readable silhouette. Moebius science-fiction, Franco-Belgian ligne claire, fine pen contours, sparse delicate hatching in shadows, luminous flat pastel gouache colours, cream paper grain, evenly spaced views, fully visible bodies, no lettering. Avoid: photorealism, 3d render, text, lettering, labels, scenery, hollow knight, white mask, drapes, bandages, mummy, robes, gore.
